researchDepth: Twelve full canonical entities,24 related-search aliases and8 shared incident claims; hierarchical trait-change/measurement/clinical, life-event and task literature with exact endpoint follow-up. Selected primary abstracts/methods/results; not12 formal systematic reviews.

entityReviews.constructReview: Relatively enduring organization, diligence, responsibility and discipline; not current monitoring or compliance.
entityReviews.measurementReview: BFI-2 organization/productiveness/responsibility facets can change unequally; responsibility reliability and invariance need explicit checks.
entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical Months–Years, very-low volatility; distinguish state expression, temporary score change and enduring within-person change. Follow-up controls and measurement invariance required; PSY130 situational wording conflict recorded.
entityReviews.unresolved: PEACH is a bundled intervention, not proof for one monitoring/planning component; existing REL044 RN retained.

entityReviews.constructReview: Enduring negative-emotionality/stress tendency, not episode anxiety, mood or diagnosis.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Trait/clinical symptom overlap and informant disagreement require independent pre/post and enduring follow-up.
entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical Months–Years, very-low volatility; distinguish state expression, temporary score change and enduring within-person change. Follow-up controls and measurement invariance required; PSY130 situational wording conflict recorded.
entityReviews.unresolved: Meta-analytic change not all randomized; no universal causal neuroticism→stress or population transfer.

entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical Months–Years, very-low volatility; distinguish state expression, temporary score change and enduring within-person change. Follow-up controls and measurement invariance required; PSY130 situational wording conflict recorded.
entityReviews.unresolved: EA30 RN; introvert fatigue/negative affect and historical-control design retained.

entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical Months–Years, very-low volatility; distinguish state expression, temporary score change and enduring within-person change. Follow-up controls and measurement invariance required; PSY130 situational wording conflict recorded.
entityReviews.unresolved: No isolated exact enduring action effect retained; life-event/therapy averages do not establish specific pathway.

existingEndpointConsultation.notes: Owner F14 has independently read all8 full propositions, endpoints and earlier primary evidence/rationales;6 RN and2 revision proposals retained. No second scientific record or changed production proposition. Later trait studies do not resolve exact endpoints, mediator independence or SRC205/207 bibliography.

hypotheses.question: One week of acting outgoing permanently increases all Extraversion facets.
hypotheses.reason: Short state/affect outcome does not demonstrate enduring multidimensional trait.

hypotheses.question: Digital coaching changes enduring conscientiousness.
hypotheses.reason: PEACH package/one-month-control, facet and observer limits; do not infer component effects.

hypotheses.question: All personality traits are immutable because categorized stable.
hypotheses.reason: Longer intervention and follow-up evidence contradict absolute immutability.

hypotheses.question: All Big Five facets change uniformly in coaching.
hypotheses.reason: Same-dataset reanalysis finds uneven facet/nuance changes and observer limits.

hypotheses.question: Repeated behavioral experiments independently reduce enduring IU.
hypotheses.reason: 12session course versuswaitlist, component and active-control/measurement alignment remain.

hypotheses.question: IU treatment changes IU which transmits anxiety reduction.
hypotheses.reason: Simultaneously improving secondary outcomes and growth models do not identify transmitted causal mediation.

hypotheses.question: Personality-targeted prevention demonstrates reduced sensation-seeking trait.
hypotheses.reason: Risk-stratified coping course targets drinking/motives; baseline moderator not trait outcome.

hypotheses.question: Completing behavioral challenges causally changes trait because completion predicts growth.
hypotheses.reason: Self-selected completion/compliance not randomized; common-method/endogeneity persists.

hypotheses.question: Need for cognition relates to elaboration/learning.
hypotheses.reason: Existing030 is primaryreviewed once; task performance and skill outcome need exact entity alignment.

hypotheses.question: Thinking curriculum works through increased Need for Cognition.
hypotheses.reason: CRT increase not NFC-mediated mechanism; tested mediation not supported, and identification not guaranteed.

hypotheses.question: Plant-closure displacement changes openness.
hypotheses.reason: Quasi-experiment stronger than raw correlation but higheducation/job-to-job subgroup and exact upstream construct unavailable; EmploymentProtection is not plantclosure.

hypotheses.question: Employment protection strength causes openness because plant closures did.
hypotheses.reason: Institutional protection rule differs from realized displacement event.

hypotheses.question: Work/relationship events precede personality change.
hypotheses.reason: Longitudinal event associations with comparison/no-comparison designs; confounding/reverse selection and common panel overlap.

hypotheses.question: Marriage/retirement inevitably transform every trait.
hypotheses.reason: Specific small/heterogeneous or no reliable event-domain findings; no general causal law.

hypotheses.question: Psychedelic intervention changes enduring openness.
hypotheses.reason: Subgroup, support setting, drug and instrument variation; no class pooling or isolated mechanism, no treatment recommendation.

hypotheses.question: Acute dopamine task sensitivity proves permanent Sensation Seeking change.
hypotheses.reason: Taskvaluation/approach versus enduring questionnaire trait and temporal scope.

hypotheses.question: Reward/punishment sensitivity relates reciprocally to later externalizing.
hypotheses.reason: Partial within-person observational replication; exact endpoint and independent mechanism missing.

hypotheses.question: Bidirectional latent panel paths prove reciprocal causes.
hypotheses.reason: Model residual/time ordering not no-unmeasured-confounder identification.

hypotheses.question: BAS equals Approach Motivation or BIS equals Anxiety.
hypotheses.reason: Trait sensitivity/state, shared item content and theoretical revisions not equality.

hypotheses.question: Trait Impulsivity equals Present Bias or inhibition task performance.
hypotheses.reason: Facet/self-report/task low convergence; beta immediatepremium not genericdiscount.

hypotheses.question: Noise/time pressure changes Need for Closure.
hypotheses.reason: Theory covers situational need; canonical time-scale conflict unresolved, not permission to edit.

hypotheses.question: How should PSY130 enduring/situational definition align with Months–Years metadata?
hypotheses.reason: No new state Driver, split or metadata repair authorized.

hypotheses.question: Cultural trait mean differences prove different latent personality.
hypotheses.reason: Specific Mini-Marker metric/scalar noninvariance; need instrument/group-specific evidence, not all-culture failure.

hypotheses.question: Stable traits affect affective susceptibility in specified inductions.
hypotheses.reason: Traitprediction plus experimentalemotion is not manipulatedtrait; exact031/041/042 causal-edge moderation not identified.

hypotheses.question: Extraversion modifies action→wellbeing under outgoing instructions.
hypotheses.reason: Evidence reports trait-dependent costs but no exact governed causal edge matching action and specific outcome; no moderator-to-outcome shortcut.

hypotheses.question: An identity cue or values-writing session changes enduring temperament.
hypotheses.reason: PriorF11 identities target separate momentary self states, not F14 trait.

hypotheses.question: Storm/illness/displacement may alter enduring traits.
hypotheses.reason: Event occurrence and postevent distress not trait change; pre-event measurement/attrition/exposure alignment absent in bounded screen.

hypotheses.question: A network delta or altered contact opportunities directly edits Extraversion.
hypotheses.reason: Scenario operation not scientific consequence, no real-person ingestion or AE target expansion.

hypotheses.question: Personality inventory item scores are constituent causal Drivers of a trait.
hypotheses.reason: Psychometric indicators not ontology components or independent causal contributors.

hypotheses.question: Biological predispositions, repeated reinforcement and socialization explain trait change.
hypotheses.reason: General mechanism prompts, not exact causal segments; long-term designs/trait measurement required.
